# Parallel processing mine
```{r parallel processing}
# Setup Parallel Processing with 20 Cores
library(future)
library(future.apply)
library(BiocParallel)
# Restrict threads globally
Sys.setenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS" = 1)
Sys.setenv("OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS" = 1)
Sys.setenv("MKL_NUM_THREADS" = 1)
Sys.setenv("NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS" = 1)
Sys.setenv("R_MAX_NUM_THREADS" = 1)
# Detect the number of available cores
cores <- min(20, parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)) # Use 20 or available cores, whichever is smaller
print(paste0("Number of cores available: ", cores))

# Configure future plan for multicore processing
plan("multisession", workers = 20)  # Linux/Unix systems

options(future.seed = TRUE)
```

# **Install and Load Required Libraries**
```{r libraries ravis, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Set memory limit for Java and reproducibility seed
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx30000m")
set.seed(100)

# List of required packages (from CRAN and Bioconductor)
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "patchwork", "Seurat","DT","ggplot2","Polychrome","future","future.apply","BiocParallel")

# Function to suppress both messages and warnings
suppress_all <- function(expr) {
  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(expr))
}

# Install and load missing packages quietly
install_and_load_packages <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    suppress_all(tryCatch({
      install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
        suppress_all(install.packages("BiocManager"))
      }
      suppress_all(BiocManager::install(package))
    }))
  }
  suppress_all(library(package, character.only = TRUE))
}

# Apply the function to install/load required packages
invisible(lapply(required_packages, install_and_load_packages))
```
# **Package Information and Citations**
```{r save packages}
# Function to write package versions and citations
write_package_info <- function(path) {
  # Get package versions
  versions <- c(paste("R", getRversion()))
  for (pkg in sort(loadedNamespaces())) {
    versions <- c(versions, paste0(pkg, ": ", packageVersion(pkg)))
  }
  
  # Extract the file name without the path and extension
  temp_file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path))
  
  # Write package versions and citations to files
  write(versions, file = file.path(path, paste0(temp_file_name, "_packages_used.txt")))
  citations <- unlist(lapply(sort(loadedNamespaces()), function(pkg) toBibtex(citation(pkg))))
  write(citations, file = file.path(path, paste0(temp_file_name, "_packages_used_citations.txt")))
  
  # Return the package versions to use outside the function
  return(versions)
}

# Call the function to write package info and save the result
package_versions <- write_package_info(path = file.path(here, "scripts", "analysis"))

# Display package versions in a datatable
datatable(data.frame("Packages" = package_versions))
```

# my code
# SCT-harmony
```{r sct pippeline}
#refractory_annotated <- SCTransform(refractory_annotated,verbose = TRUE, return.only.var.genes = TRUE,
#                                         assay = "RNA",n_genes = NULL, variable.features.n = NULL)

Combined_hpa <- merge(regeneration_annotated, y = c(refractory_annotated), project = "Combined_hpa")
# Split SCT assay by method
Combined_hpa[["RNA"]] <- split(Combined_hpa[["RNA"]], f = Combined_hpa$orig.ident)
Combined_hpa <- SCTransform(Combined_hpa, verbose = TRUE)


Combined_hpa <- RunPCA(Combined_hpa,npcs = 30, verbose = F)
Combined_hpa <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = Combined_hpa,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  method = RPCAIntegration,
  new.reduction = 'rpca.int',
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  verbose = T,
)

Combined_hpa[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(Combined_hpa[["RNA"]])

Combined_hpa <- FindNeighbors(Combined_hpa,reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
Combined_hpa <- FindClusters(Combined_hpa, resolution = 2, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
Combined_hpa <- RunUMAP(Combined_hpa, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
saveRDS(Combined_hpa, file = "/storage/home/bucekl/refractory_12/data/processed/integrated_obj_rpca.rds")

```
# GPT
```{r gpt sol}
# Set RNA assay as active and normalize refractory dataset
DefaultAssay(refractory_annotated) <- "RNA"
refractory_annotated <- NormalizeData(refractory_annotated, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
refractory_annotated <- FindVariableFeatures(refractory_annotated, selection.method = "vst")

# Set RNA assay as active and normalize regeneration dataset
DefaultAssay(regeneration_annotated) <- "RNA"
regeneration_annotated <- NormalizeData(regeneration_annotated, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
regeneration_annotated <- FindVariableFeatures(regeneration_annotated, selection.method = "vst")

integration_features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = list(refractory_annotated, regeneration_annotated), nfeatures = 10000, fvf.nfeatures = 10000)
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = list(refractory_annotated, regeneration_annotated), anchor.features = integration_features, dims = 1:30)
Combined_obj <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, dims = 1:30)


```
## Merging and data scaling
```{r} 
refractory_annotated <- NormalizeData(refractory_annotated)
refractory_annotated <- FindVariableFeatures(refractory_annotated)
refractory_annotated <- ScaleData(refractory_annotated)
refractory_annotated <- RunPCA(refractory_annotated)

regeneration_annotated <- NormalizeData(regeneration_annotated, assay = "RNA")
regeneration_annotated <- FindVariableFeatures(regeneration_annotated, assay = "RNA")
regeneration_annotated <- ScaleData(regeneration_annotated, assay = "RNA")
regeneration_annotated <- RunPCA(regeneration_annotated)

# Set RNA as the active assay for both objects
DefaultAssay(regeneration_annotated) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(refractory_annotated) <- "RNA"

Combined_obj <- merge(regeneration_annotated, y = refractory_annotated, project = "Combined_obj")
all.genes <- rownames(Combined_obj)
Combined_obj <- NormalizeData(Combined_obj)
Combined_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(Combined_obj)
Combined_obj <- ScaleData(Combined_obj, features = all.genes)
```

## Integration 
```{r integration, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width = 16.2}
Combined_obj
#saveRDS(Combined_obj, file = #"home/bucekl/projects/refractory_12/data/processed/combined_obj.rds")
Combined_obj <- IntegrateLayers(object = Combined_obj, method = CCAIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = FALSE)

#rejoin layers 
Combined_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(Combined_obj[["RNA"]])
########gpt Scale integrated data

Combined_obj <- FindNeighbors(Combined_obj, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:30)
Combined_obj <- FindClusters(Combined_obj, resolution = 2)
Combined_obj <- RunUMAP(Combined_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.cca")

# Visualization

# Define a distinct color palette for clusters
cluster_colors <- Polychrome::createPalette(length(levels(Combined_obj$seurat_clusters)), c("#ff0000", "#00ff00", "#0000ff"))
# Ensure cluster_colors is a named vector

cluster_labels <- as.character(0:(length(levels(Combined_obj$seurat_clusters))-1))  # Creates labels from "0" to "31"
names(cluster_colors) <- cluster_labels  # Assign each color to a cluster label

# Generate the UMAP plot
plot_data <- FetchData(Combined_obj, vars = c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2", "seurat_clusters"))

# Ensure color mapping aligns
plot_data$seurat_clusters <- factor(plot_data$seurat_clusters, levels = names(cluster_colors))

# Create ggplot manually
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = seurat_clusters)) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle("UMAP with Distinguishable Colors")


saveRDS(Combined_obj, file = "/storage/home/bucekl/refractory_12/data/processed/integrated_obj.rds")

```
